newsitem.title: ITALY: ITALY'S ENEL REJECTS TALK OF OMNITEL/OLIVETTI BID.
newsitem.headline: ITALY'S ENEL REJECTS TALK OF OMNITEL/OLIVETTI BID.

text.p: Italian electricity utility Enel on Tuesday rejected a newspaper report that it was planning a bid for information technology group Olivetti and its controlling stake in mobile phone consortium Omnitel.
"Enel categorically denies any suggestion that it might buy Omnitel directly or through its controlling arm, Olivetti," state owned Enel said in a two line statement.
German economic daily Handelsblatt newspaper said in an advance copy of a story to appear on Wednesday that Enel Deutsche Telekom planned to make a bid for Olivetti to take control of Omnitel.
A Deutsche Telekom spokesman in Germany said the report was "pure speculation."
Olivetti holds a controlling stake in Omnitel Pronto Italia, Italy's second mobile phone operator.

The Telekom spokesman confirmed previous reports from Italian officials that it and Enel planned to make a bid for Italy's third mobile phone licence, which is due to be offered at tender later this year.
